verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a local REST API with a published OpenAPI spec, a gRPC API, a CLI, an MCP server, and an agents skill toolkit. None of these is an official client SDK or language library. A raw API spec is a developer building block, and the CLI, MCP server and skill are adjacent features, so none of them counts toward an official-SDK story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
